thread: Diego (Marketing): Quick kickoff: need a compact benchmark asset pack for the Serving Wins launch. Must show latency vs cost story, have accessible color variants, and include a webinar hero with a small "Dedicated vs Hosted" two-column callout. Deadline next Tue EOD.  Ben (Creative Ops): Please list deliverables and formats.  Diego (Marketing): Deliverables: 1) Benchmark tile (SVG + PNG 1x/2x + Figma components), 2) Social hero set (LinkedIn 1200x628, X 1600x900, IG 1080x1080, carousel 1080x1350, mobile banner 640x360), 3) Webinar slide 1920x1080 (16:9 export), 4) One-page PDF diagram with sparkline and footnote, 5) Accessibility contrast screenshots. CTA: "Try Redwood Inference"; alt CTA: "Ship with Redwood".  Ava (Design): Quick Qs: brand tokens? dark-mode? localization?  Priya (Product Marketing): Use core brand palette plus a high-contrast mono variant. Localize EN, DE, FR but prioritize EN for socials. Copy options: A) "Lower latency. Fewer dollars. Predictable inference." B) "Run LLMs reliably at scale and at cost." C) "Serve smarter: faster responses, lower unit cost." Use A default.  Eli (Legal): No numeric claims without data and test plan. Use footnote: "Based on internal tests; results vary by model and config."  Ava (Design): I'll create a Figma file with components and three visual variants: light, dark, high-contrast. Breakpoints: 1920x1080, 1200x675, 640x360. Will include alt-text suggestions and export slices.  figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-kit — components: /bench-tiles, /social-heroes, /webinar-slide  Ben (Creative Ops): Timeline: Ava 3 business days for first pass, me 1 day for QA/exports. Export checklist: SVG master, PNG@1x/2x per size, PDF one-pager with visible footnote layer, Figma handoff link, contrast screenshots.  Diego (Marketing): Add two-column callout on the webinar slide for Dedicated vs Hosted benefits (icons for routing, latency, cost). Legal to confirm footnote placement before final PDF.  Priya (Product Marketing): I'll drop approved EN copy in Figma and prep webinar notes.  Eli (Legal): I'll review the exported PDF footnote before distribution.  Ben (Creative Ops): Kicking off. Call out any scope creep (animations, extra languages). :rocket:
